definitions.explanation: A division of the academic year.

1{学期|がっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My grades for the first term were good.

notes:
{学期|がっき} means semester or school term.

FORMS:
{学|がく} (study) + {期|き} (period).

JAPANESE SCHOOL SYSTEM:
Most Japanese schools use a three-term system:
- 1{学期|がっき} (⟦{一学期|いちがっき}→一学期：17203_ichigakki⟧): April–July
- 2{学期|がっき} (⟦{二学期|にがっき}→二学期：23891_nigakki⟧): September–December
- 3{学期|がっき} (⟦{三学期|さんがっき}→三学期：30250_sangakki⟧): January–March

Some universities use a two-semester system:
- ⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧: first semester (spring)
- ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧: second semester (fall)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {学期|がっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まり：02474_hajimari⟧: start of the term
- {学期|がっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧: end of the term
- ⟦{学期末|がっきまつ}→学期末：27585_gakkimatsu⟧: end of term
- ⟦{学期末|がっきまつ}→学期末：27585_gakkimatsu⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: end-of-term exams

CULTURAL NOTE: The Japanese school year starts in April, coinciding with the cherry blossom season.
